messages:
jess_cs: Heads-up — Oxbridge Health sent back a SIG/CAIQ + a bespoke security questionnaire and want KMS/HSM proof, audit-log retention evidence, and key-rotation policy by EOD in 3 days. They tagged security and compliance contacts. Can someone own the evidence bundle? They specifically call out: 90-day audit log retention, KMS key policy JSON, HSM attestation (vendor + cert), and a sample of redacted audit logs. They also asked if we charge for scoped log exports. @sam_sec @ryan_sre :eyes:

sam_sec: I can take the KMS/HSM items. Quick clarifying q's: do they need a signed attestation from our HSM vendor or is a vendor name + cert ok? Also confirm whether Oxbridge is on Hosted API or Dedicated — HSM attestation differs.

jess_cs: They're on Hosted API (no Dedicated contract). Customer security contact: security@oxbridge.health. They said "evidence suitable for internal audit" so probably need vendor cert + configuration screenshots.

sam_sec: Got it. For Hosted: we can provide key metadata and rotation policy (redacted). For HSM, we have an HSM Partner Attestation PDF from Thales/Luna in our compliance bucket. I'll pull it and attach. Example KMS metadata snippet I'll prepare: ```json
{
  "key_id": "redwood-hosted-kms-prod-1",
  "created_at": "2024-11-02T16:12:03Z",
  "rotation_enabled": true,
  "rotation_period": "90 days"
}
```

ryan_sre: For audit logs they want 90-day retention. Our default IRL retention is 365 days in CloudWatch/Splunk; Hosted short-term dashboards keep 90-day indices. We can export a redacted slice. Note: full export of raw audit logs (~200GB) will incur egress/processing cost. If they only need examples and a manifest we can provide a 30MB zipped sample plus an export manifest.

michael_support: We should confirm billing question with finance. Short answer: we typically absorb small-scope evidence pulls but charge for large-scale log exports (>50GB) per the T&Cs. I'll loop in finance if Oxbridge requests full raw export.

alice_product: We already have a prefilled CAIQ for Hosted API that covers most questions; saving time. If security wants, I can attach the CAIQ PDF and mark fields that are bespoke. :thumbsup:

sam_sec: Attestation plan: 1) attach CAIQ (alice_product) 2) attach KMS key metadata + rotation policy (me) 3) attach HSM vendor cert (me) 4) provide redacted audit log sample + manifest (ryan_sre). I'll prepare notes on redaction.

ops-bot: Ticket created #CS-2024-4498 for Oxbridge evidence request. Deadline set: 3 days (2024-11-10).

jess_cs: Perfect. Two small extras from the customer: a) They want a canonical statement saying we don't store customer plaintext (they asked about token retention), b) a contact to sign an NDA for deeper log export. Can legal confirm? @emily_legal

emily_legal: We can provide a standard data-retention statement. For NDA: yes we can execute a mutual NDA, but need SSO contact + PO. Send me their legal contact and I'll fast-track.

ryan_sre: Upload plan: I'll produce a redacted log sample (contain only event_time, service, action, resource, actor_id) — strip request bodies/response bodies. Example line: `2024-10-28T14:03:12Z host-api request auth: token_verification user=oxbridge-service action=Generate model=gpt-3.5 status=200`. I'll keep <=50MB sample.

sam_sec: One more: Oxbridge asked for evidence that KMS keys are stored in HSM-backed KMS and not plaintext in our DB. I'll include a short paragraph and link to our KMS design doc.

jess_cs: ETA check — can we get the bundle ready in ~36 hours? Customer said they'd escalate internally if we miss the deadline.

michael_support: I can do a 36h turnaround on coordination. Finance and legal are looped. ops-bot created the ticket so we'll track.

sam_sec: I'll upload KMS metadata + HSM attestation by EOD today (in ~6h). Ryan — can you confirm the redacted log sample availability?

ryan_sre: Yes, I can push the sample in ~24h. If we need signed timestamps we might need extra time to get notarized certs (not usually requested).

jess_cs: Thanks all. I'll update Oxbridge with interim response: CAIQ + statement + planned attachments and confirm whether they want full export (note potential charges).
